<MethodEndpoint
  method={"put"}
  path={"/api/devices/{installId}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Upserts the latest device state for the authenticated member. A shared
installation is rebound to the current account after login. The
mobile app calls this at launch/foreground only when a reported field
changes or has not yet been reported to this server/account; identical
payloads are no-ops. No request/open timestamps or activity history
are stored. Device data is sent only to this server.

At most 20 devices are retained per member. Older clients can continue
using the server without reporting.
